newsitem.title: CHINA: Moody's updates ratings outlook for Korea banks.
newsitem.headline: Moody's updates ratings outlook for Korea banks.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday the updated outlook is negative for the long-term rating of Housing & Commercial Bank of Korea, Industrial Bank of Korea, Korea Development Bank and Export-Import Bank of Korea.

The rating outlook reflects the negative outlook for Korea's sovereign rating ceiling of A1, which is in turn the result of the vulnerablity posed by the deteriorating financial condition of the country's corporate and banking sectors and the substantial rise in short-term external debt, Moody's said in a statement.
The outlook for the country's rating also incorporates the accelerating deterioration of North Korea and the increased likelihood of a sudden collapse, the rating agency said.
The long-term ratings of the banks, all based in Seoul, were noy currently being considered for potential changes, Moody's said.
